verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a built-in agent for exploring segments and analyzing campaign performance in natural language inside the product (hightouch-docs-19). AI Decisioning also uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel, and timing per customer and measures what worked (hightouch-docs-14, hightouch-docs-46). The MCP server adds natural-language performance analysis, though through an external assistant rather than inside the product (hightouch-docs-56). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the built-in agent's insight and suggestion capabilities (it rests on a single overview sentence), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the in-product AI insights work as described.
